newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-Authentic files for 4.1mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-Authentic files for 4.1mln shrs.

text.p: Authentic Specialty Foods Inc filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering of up to 4.1 million common shares it expects to sell between $9 and $11 each.
Underwriters for the offering, Crittenden Roth Inc, Principal Financial Securities Inc and Stephens Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 615,000 shares.

The Grand Prairie, Texas, company that provides an extensive line of Mexican food products said proceeds from the sale, an estimated $37 million, will be used to repurchase 1,538,500 shares and to acquire the remaining interest in La Victoria Foods Inc. and to reduce debt.
After the offering, the company will have 6,361,500 shares outstanding.
For the three months ended March 31, the company reported net income of $126,000, or 7 cents a share, that compares to net income of $7,000, or 0 cents a share, in the year-earlier period.
